Application failure metadata and both saved-report readers retain only recognized matching SQLite numeric codes and constant names, without messages, query text, paths or locals.

storage_comparison.sample_scope: Full-copy allocation, no trading or cgroup qualification

storage_limits: Synthetic 53300-row database matches the last duration progress file size, not the actual host account contents; the post-shutdown host source is 24576 bytes larger.
Comparison measures allocated copy bytes on tmpfs versus disk. It does not measure a cgroup peak reduction, failure causality or stable resource headroom.
Disk page cache can still be charged to memory; moving the copy removes tmpfs allocation, not all report memory or CPU demand.
Single sequential copy durations are not a throughput benchmark; cache/scheduler effects are not controlled.
